fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials and commentary on Miami civic affairs and publicity, including discussion of a proposed recall of city commissioners, local political campaigns and labor vote-buying concerns, and criticism of civic boosterism. Coverage includes the Miami Chamber of Commerce parade and local band controversies (Bayfront Park/Bayshore Park), notes on school administration and coeducation, and debate over a proposed post office site versus a union station. Includes letters to the editor, local notices related to the upcoming Shrine convention, and substantial local advertising for businesses, entertainment venues, transportation, and services in Greater Miami.
